title: Public Law 119-138: Accelerating Access to Critical Therapies for ALS Reauthorization Act of 2026
summary: H.R. 8205, "Accelerating Access to Critical Therapies for ALS Reauthorization Act of 2026", originated in the House of the 119th Congress and became Public Law 119-138 on 2026-11-03, according to Congress.gov.
